title: Integer polyhedral chains on unit lattice faces are integer multiplicity with mass Σ|β|
statement: Assume as a hypothesis (MR), exactly as in the selected theorem: M_W(T) = R.measure(W) for every open W whenever the IMRep R represents T on an open U. Let P, k ∈ ℕ, let s be a finite set of index pairs p = (ι, b) with ι : Fin k → Fin P strictly increasing, and let β assign an integer to each pair. Let T ∈ 𝒟_k(Euclid P) (domain univ) satisfy T(ω) = Σ_{p∈s} β_p ∫_{(0,1)^k} ω(Φ_p y)(e_{ι(0)}, …, e_{ι(k−1)}) dy for all test k-forms ω, where Φ_p(y) := b + Σ_j y_j e_{ι(j)}; for k = 0 this is evaluation at the lattice points b. Then T is integer multiplicity, M(T) = ENNReal.ofReal(Σ_{p∈s}|β_p|), and T = 0 or M(T) ≥ 1.
lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) → ∀ (P k : ℕ) (s : Finset ((Fin k → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ))) (β : (Fin k → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ) → ℤ) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k), (∀ p ∈ s, StrictMono p.1) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, T ω = ∑ p ∈ s, (β p : ℝ) * ∫ y in {y : Euclid k | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ))) → IsIntegerMultiplicity T ∧ T.mass = ENNReal.ofReal (∑ p ∈ s, |(β p : ℝ)|) ∧ (T = 0 ∨ 1 ≤ T.mass)
